events.time: Tenev keynote 17:30 CT / 18:30 ET (Wed 08:30 AEST); day 2 Sep 30
events.title: Robinhood HOOD Summit '26 'Engines of Creation', Houston (Sep 29-30)
events.why: Watchlist and loved company; new product launches are the usual stock catalyst.

events.title: US JOLTS job openings, August
events.why: First labour read of the week ahead of Friday's payrolls.

events.title: OpenAI DevDay 2026, San Francisco (managed agents expected)
events.why: Agent and pricing announcements set the competitive bar for Anthropic, Cursor, GOOGL and META.

events.time: 14:30 AEST decision, 15:30 AEST presser (00:30 ET Tue)
events.title: RBA cash rate decision (meeting Sep 28-29); markets price ~92-94% odds of +25bp to 4.60%
events.why: All four majors forecast a hike; the AUD reaction translates the whole US book overnight.

events.title: US August PCE inflation + Q2 GDP third estimate (also starts BEA annual revisions)
events.why: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge; annual revisions can reshape the growth picture.

events.time: After US close; call 16:30 ET (Thu 06:30 AEST)
events.title: Micron fiscal Q4 2026 results (guide $50B +/- $1B; consensus ~$50.6B, EPS ~$31.3)
events.why: Holding and memory bellwether; HBM4 pricing and 2027 supply commentary; options price ~10% move.

events.title: BoJ September Tankan (large manufacturers seen +26, up 4)
events.why: AI/semis demand read for Japan (Keyence, Toyota) and a BoJ hike input.

events.title: BYD September sales
events.why: Watchlist; August was the 2026 high with overseas +86% YTD - checks whether that held.

events.time: 13:30 ET (Fri 03:30 AEST); Waller 10:00 ET, Bowman 15:00 ET
events.title: Fed Vice Chair Jefferson on 'US Economy and Monetary Policy'; Waller and Bowman also speak
events.why: Most policy-relevant Fed remarks in the window; no Warsh appearance is on the Fed calendar.

events.time: Shanghai closed Oct 1-7, reopens Oct 8; HKEX closed Oct 1
events.title: China National Day Golden Week market closure
events.why: Thin trading for BABA, BYD, CATL; mainland news backs up into Oct 8.

events.title: US ISM manufacturing PMI, September (August 54.6)
events.why: Industrial capex pulse for GEV, TER, Siemens Energy and machinery names.

events.title: Tesla next-gen Roadster unveil, Waco TX
events.why: Watchlist; sentiment event the night before Q3 deliveries; production not before 2027-28.

events.title: US September jobs report (no shutdown - CR funds government to Dec 11)
events.why: Biggest macro print of the window; sets October FOMC (Oct 27-28) pricing.

events.title: Tesla Q3 production and deliveries (consensus ~454k; GS 435k, Barclays 475k)
events.why: Watchlist; Q2 delivered 480k+, so a miss vs consensus would show a q/q decline.

events.title: Sydney daylight saving starts: US open is now 00:30 AEDT
events.why: All US times shift one hour later on the owner's clock from here on.

events.title: US ISM services PMI, September
events.why: Services is most of the economy; prices-paid component feeds the inflation debate.

events.title: CME/Silicon Data H100 and B200 GPU rental-index futures launch
events.why: First tradable price for AI compute; a public signal on GPU rental rates for NVDA and neoclouds.

events.time: Oct 6-7, from 00:01 PT / 03:01 ET (18:01 AEDT Tue)
events.title: Amazon Prime Big Deal Days (22 countries incl. Australia)
events.why: Holding; early holiday-demand read for AMZN retail and ads.

events.title: Marvell Investor Day, New York
events.why: Holding; multi-year TAM and custom-silicon targets are the main catalyst before earnings.

events.time: Oct 7 or 8, TBC (Korean press leans Thu Oct 8); KST morning, ~10:00 AEDT
events.title: Samsung Electronics Q3 preliminary earnings (consensus ~107T won op profit, 200T revenue)
events.why: First hard Q3 memory profit number and first 100T-won quarter if consensus holds; read-across to MU and SK hynix.

events.title: FOMC minutes from the Sep 15-16 meeting
events.why: Shows how split the committee is on the path of cuts under Warsh.

events.title: TSMC September revenue (Q3 results follow Oct 15)
events.why: Holding; completes Q3 revenue vs guidance; August was +53% y/y.

events.title: OCP Global Summit (open compute: racks, networking, power); US bond market shut for Columbus Day
events.why: Data-centre hardware roadmaps for NVDA, MRVL, ALAB, CRDO, AVGO.

events.time: JPM results ~07:00 ET (22:00 AEDT), call 08:30 ET (23:30 AEDT); GS, WFC, C same morning
events.title: Q3 bank earnings start: JPMorgan, Goldman, Wells Fargo, Citi (BAC, MS Oct 14)
events.why: Opens Q3 season; JPM consensus ~$5.83 EPS on ~$50.6B revenue; credit and dealmaking commentary sets the tone.
